page_title: Turn Business Processes Into Live Apps | Taskade Genesis

summary.name: Taskade Genesis
summary.one_liner: Taskade Genesis is an AI app builder that turns a text prompt into a hosted business app (such as a CRM, dashboard, or client portal) with data, AI agents, and automations included.
use_cases: Build a CRM or sales pipeline tracker from a prompt
Create a branded client portal with sign-in
Track customer churn and health with a dashboard
Automate workflows such as Stripe invoicing or Slack notifications
Embed an AI assistant on a website
summary.what_it_does: Taskade Genesis generates a full-stack app from a single natural-language prompt, combining projects and databases, AI agents, and automations in one workspace. Apps can be published as branded portals with built-in sign-in and custom domains. Automations offer branching, looping, and filtering across 100+ integrations, with retries on failed steps. AI agents can be published publicly or embedded on a website, trained on files and URLs, and given custom tool schemas and persistent memory. The page also offers ready-made app templates that can be cloned and modified.
notable: Prompt-to-app generation with memory, agents, and automations wired together
Clone ready-made app templates such as CRMs, dashboards, and trackers
Export apps to GitHub or import .tsk files
Bring your own AI key (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI, and others) on paid plans
caveats: Free plan has 1 AI agent, 10 automation runs per month, basic integrations, and no AI credits at start
Pro is $10/mo billed annually; higher TSK modes and advanced features require paid plans (Business and up for TSK-Reasoning)
Automations on the free plan are limited, and importing an app that includes automations needs a paid plan
